description: A script for parsing Visual Studio solution files (.sln), extracting project dependencies, and printing build order and project info.

methods.name: BuildProject
methods.description: Recursively builds a project after its dependencies are built, printing the project name.

methods.name: ParseSolution
methods.description: Parses a solution file to extract projects and their dependencies.

methods.name: PrintDependencies
methods.description: Prints all projects with their dependencies.

methods.name: PrintBuildOrder
methods.description: Prints the order in which projects should be built based on dependencies.

methods.name: PrintVCProj
methods.description: Generates Visual Studio project files for each project.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point; orchestrates parsing, printing dependencies, build order, and optionally project files.
